svg.text: LEFT side col: 80 MODE 70 TAP 60 SYNC 50 BPM- 40 BPM+ 30 LOOP-IN 20 LOOP-OUT 10 PANIC
RIGHT side col: 89 DUAL-SONG 79 DECK-SETUP 69/59/49/39/29/19 unused
Entry: SOLO = default | PER-ROW = double-tap SOLO (r7 c3) | DUAL-SONG = right note 89 (hold=peek, double-tap=latch) | CONTROL = left note 80 (hold=peek, double-tap=latch)
Stubs: MUTE/REV/STUT/HALF/DBL/KILL inert (visual only); HOLD = SHIFT (no one-shot); SOLO = per-row toggle (no stem solo); FX bus = visual/status only. PANIC = triple-tap (1000ms).
